conflict.title: Output File Conflict
conflict.description: The following output locations already have files with the same name. Please choose how to handle them.
conflict.sameAsInput: Output path is the same as the input file. A safe replacement flow will be used.
conflict.existingFile: A file already exists at the output location.
conflict.overwriteDesc: Replace the existing file with the compressed version (safe: uses temp file first)
conflict.renameDesc: Save with an auto-incremented filename (e.g. video_1.mp4)
conflict.skipDesc: Skip this file and continue with others
conflict.warning: Overwrite uses a safe flow: ShrinkFlow generates a temporary file first, verifies compression succeeded, then replaces the existing file. If compression fails, the original file is preserved.

smartShrink.title: Smart Shrink Plan
smartShrink.subtitle: Analyze file size, duration, resolution, and bitrate to decide which videos are worth compressing.

light.name: Safe Optimize
light.desc: Only compress clearly worthwhile videos while prioritizing visual quality.

balanced.name: Smart Recommend
balanced.desc: Recommend a balanced plan based on bitrate, resolution, and file size.

deep.name: Space Saver
deep.desc: Prioritize smaller file size. High-risk videos require confirmation before compression.

folderBudget.name: Folder Budget
folderBudget.desc: Compress the entire folder to a target size.

notice.estimateOnly: Estimated savings and quality risks are based on metadata. Actual results may vary after compression.

notice.noSelectedVideos: No videos selected for compression. Adjust the plan or manually select videos.
notice.deepReplaceWarning: Space Saver has higher quality risk. Consider saving to a different location or keeping the original files.
notice.smartPlanControlling: Smart Plan is controlling compression. Each video may use its own recommended mode.
notice.fallbackModeOnly: The highlighted mode is the fallback only; each video uses its own recommended mode.
